# This code is intended to assist in following the analysis run in the "Everyday Empathy" paper. Can reporduce findings by reading in longform data as df, and wideform data as dfnorep.  

```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(hausekeep)
require(lme4)
require(lmerTest)

```


```{r Frequency of empathy opps, empathy both experienced and recieved}

# 0.21

df$T_opp %>% mean()
# 0.12

# Mean of participant means
na.omit(dfnorep$T_oppmeans) %>% mean()


#Proportion of opportunities empathy occurred
na.omit(df$E) %>% mean()
# 0.88
```

```{r Co-occurrence of components when experiencing and receiving empathy}
#this code shows us how many cases there are when ES, PT and comp occur in diff. combos

df$E_Opp %>% sum()
na.omit(df$E) %>% sum()
na.omit(df$missed_E_opp) %>% sum()
# Ptpcts reproted a total of 883 E opps, empathizing 783 of these. ALso reported 365 missed E opps. 

#Looking at the numbers overall (some ptcpts overrepresented)
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "1" & ES == "1" & PT == "1"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "0" & ES == "1" & PT == "1"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "1" & ES == "0" & PT == "1"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "1" & ES == "1" & PT == "0"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "1" & ES == "0" & PT == "0"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "0" & ES == "0" & PT == "0"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "0" & ES == "0" & PT == "1"]))
with(df[!is.na(df$ES),], length(ES[comp == "0" & ES == "1" & PT == "0"]))



# there are 36 cases where compassion doesn't occur
# there are 109 cases where emotion sharing doesn't
# there are 124 cases where PT doesn't occur

#In all of our reports of feeling empathy, all 3 components were reported 75% of the time

#However, as mentioned some ptcpts are over repped, so we will calc proportions of each combination of components per participant. Means of these proportions will account for each participant equally. 
props_EP <- c()
props_EPC <- c()
props_EC <- c()
props_PC <- c()
props_E <- c()
props_P <- c()
props_C <- c()
props_0 <- c()


for (i in unique(df$User_Id)){
  prop_EP <- with(df, length(ES[ES==1 & PT == 1 & comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_EPC <- with(df, length(ES[ES==1 & PT == 1 & comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_EC <- with(df, length(ES[ES==1 & PT == 0 & comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_PC <- with(df, length(ES[ES==0 & PT == 1 & comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_E <- with(df, length(ES[ES==1 & PT == 0 & comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_P <- with(df, length(ES[ES==0 & PT == 1 & comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_C <- with(df, length(ES[ES==0 & PT == 0 & comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  prop_0 <- with(df, length(ES[ES==0 & PT == 0 & comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & E == 1 & !is.na(ES)]))
  

  
  props_EP <<- c(props_EP, prop_EP)
  props_EPC <<- c(props_EPC, prop_EPC)
  props_EC <<- c(props_EC, prop_EC)
  props_PC <<- c(props_PC, prop_PC)
  props_E <<- c(props_E, prop_E)
  props_C <<- c(props_C, prop_C)
  props_P <<- c(props_P, prop_P)
  props_0 <<- c(props_0, prop_0)
  
  
}
na.omit(props_P)%>% mean()
na.omit(props_C) %>% mean()
na.omit(props_E) %>% mean()
na.omit(props_EC) %>% mean()
na.omit(props_PC) %>% mean()
na.omit(props_EP) %>% mean()
na.omit(props_EPC) %>% mean()
na.omit(props_0) %>% mean()

na.omit(props_P)%>% sd()
na.omit(props_C) %>% sd()
na.omit(props_E) %>% sd()

#there are 92 times when PT wasn't received

# Those are overall proportions, now we can calculate per participant mean proportions
T_props_EP <- c()
T_props_EPC <- c()
T_props_EC <- c()
T_props_PC <- c()
T_props_E <- c()
T_props_P <- c()
T_props_C <- c()

for (i in unique(df$User_Id)){
  T_prop_EP <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==1 & T_PT == 1 & T_comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_EPC <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==1 & T_PT == 1 & T_comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_EC <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==1 & T_PT == 0 & T_comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_PC <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==0 & T_PT == 1 & T_comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_E <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==1 & T_PT == 0 & T_comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_P <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==0 & T_PT == 1 & T_comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_C <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==0 & T_PT == 0 & T_comp == 1 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  T_prop_0 <- with(df, length(T_ES[T_ES==0 & T_PT == 0 & T_comp == 0 & User_Id == i & !is.na(T_ES)])/ length(SurveysAnswered[User_Id ==i & T_opp == 1 & !is.na(T_ES)]))
  
  
  
  T_props_EP <<- c(T_props_EP, T_prop_EP)
  T_props_EPC <<- c(T_props_EPC, T_prop_EPC)
  T_props_EC <<- c(T_props_EC, T_prop_EC)
  T_props_PC <<- c(T_props_PC, T_prop_PC)
  T_props_E <<- c(T_props_E, T_prop_E)
  T_props_C <<- c(T_props_C, T_prop_C)
  T_props_P <<- c(T_props_P, T_prop_P)
  T_props_0 <<- c(T_props_0, T_prop_0)
  
  
}
```

```{r Extent of components correlation}

cor.test(df$ES_extent, df$PT_extent)
cor.test(df$comp_extent, df$PT_extent)
cor.test(df$comp_extent, df$ES_extent)

# strongly correlated

#robust to nested nature of data
summaryh(lmer(ES_extent ~ PT_extentPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
summaryh(lmer(ES_extent ~ comp_extentPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
summaryh(lmer(comp_extent ~ PT_extentPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))


```

```{r closeness}

#Relative proportions of closeness ratings in empathy opps from total stranger (1) to very close relationship (7)
table(df$E_how_close)

# Empathize or not given opportunity by closeness
summaryh(glmer(E ~ E_how_closePC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, family = binomial))

# Extent of empathy and ptcpt centered closeness
summaryh(lmer(ExtentAvg_score ~ E_how_closePC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))


```

```{r Empathy and subjective well-being}

### Trait empathy measures and SWB 
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ IRI_PT_score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = 0.25, SE = 0.13, t(237) = 2.03, p = .044, r = 0.13
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ IRI_EC_score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = 0.05, SE = 0.13, t(236) = 0.40, p = .692, r = 0.03
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ IRI_PD_score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#b = -0.47, SE = 0.10, t(236) = -4.46, p < .001, r = 0.28
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ IRI_F_score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# b = -0.01, SE = 0.10, t(235) = -0.14, p = .890, r = 0.009
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ EI_BC_score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
# b = -0.27, SE = 0.12, t(236) = -2.35, p = .019, r = 0.15
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ EI_Emp_score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = -0.33, SE = 0.11, t(236) = -2.89, p = .004, r = 0.19
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ SITES_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = 0.10, SE = 0.09, t(236) = 1.02, p = .309, r = 0.07
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ ChoicesOther_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
# b = -0.003, SE = 0.01, t(236) = -0.22, p = .830, r = 0.01
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
# b = 0.13, SE = 0.06, t(236) = 2.13, p = .035, r = 0.14
tab_model(lmer(formula = SWB ~ IRI_PT_score_C + IRI_EC_score_C + IRI_F_score_C + IRI_PD_score_C + EI_BC_score_C + EI_Emp_score_C + SITES_C + ChoicesOther_C + Mall_of_E_Score_C + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))


tSWBtraitE <- c(2.03, .40, -4.46, -0.14, -2.355, -2.89, 1.02, -0.22, 2.13)
pSWBtraitE <- c(0.044, 0.692, 0.0000129, 0.890, 0.019, 0.004, 0.309, 0.830, 0.035)
namesSWBtraitE <- c("Perspective Taking (IRI)", "Empathic Concern (IRI)", "Personal Distress (IRI)", "Fantasy (IRI)", "Behavioural Contagion (EI)", "Empathy (EI)", "Single Item Trait Empathy Scale", "Empathy Selection Task", "Malleability of Empathy")
adjpSWBTraitE <- p.adjust(pSWBtraitE, method = "fdr", n = length(pSWBtraitE))
SESWBbyTraitE <- 
SWBbyTraitE <- data.frame(namesSWBtraitE, tSWBtraitE, round(adjpSWBTraitE, digits = 4)) 
tab_df(SWBbyTraitE, title = "Subjective Well-being Predicted by Trait Empathy", col.header = c("Trait Empathy Predictor", "t score", "Adjusted p value"), footnote = "Table 8. Shows t scores and FDR adjusted p values for trait empathy scales predicting subjective well-being", show.footnote = TRUE, alternate.rows = TRUE)
#No sig associations after adjusting for FDR between trait empathy and subjective well-being

rm(tSWBtraitE, pSWBtraitE, namesSWBtraitE, adjpSWBTraitE, SWBbyTraitE)

### WHat about empathy in everyday life and subjective well-being, may uncover associations that global measures did not (Runyam 2018, Shiffman 2008)

StateE_SWBmodel <- lmer(formula = SWB ~ ExtentAvg_PC + PDPC + ConfAvg_PC + DiffAvg_PC + valencePC + Gen_Prosocial + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df)
tab_model(StateE_SWBmodel)



### Daily empathy

# Within-subject effects

# degreesfree   t       p
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ E_Opp + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#   b = 0.18, SE = 0.03, t(6615) = 6.72, p < .001, r = 0.08 
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ E + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#    E b = 0.25, SE = 0.08, t(1231) = 3.08, p = .002, r = 0.09
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ ES + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = 0.21, SE = 0.09, t(1084) = 2.50, p = .012, r = 0.08
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ PT + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = -0.10, SE = 0.08, t(1074) = -1.24, p = .214, r = 0.04
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ comp + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = 0.26, SE = 0.13, t(1133) = 2.02, p = .043, r = 0.06
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ ES_extentPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#        b = 0.08, SE = 0.03, t(875) = 3.25, p = .001, r = 0.11
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ PT_extentPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#       b = 0.06, SE = 0.02, t(804) = 2.96, p = .003, r = 0.10
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ comp_extentPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#        b = 0.16, SE = 0.03, t(938) = 5.61, p < .001, r = 0.18
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ ExtentAvg_PC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
#       b = 0.17, SE = 0.03, t(992) = 5.73, p < .001, r = 0.18
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ DiffAvg_PC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000))))
# b = -0.12, SE = 0.03, t(967) = -4.61, p < .001, r = 0.15
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ ConfAvg_PC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#       b = 0.26, SE = 0.04, t(969) = 6.98, p < .001, r = 0.22
summary(lmer(SWB ~ T_extentAvg_PC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#        b = 0.20, SE = 0.04, t(614) = 5.16, p < .001, r = 0.20
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ valencePC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#     b = 0.15, SE = 0.01, t(1132) = 10.31, p < .001, r = 0.29
summary(lmer(formula = SWB ~ PDPC + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#       b = -0.14, SE = 0.01, t(1152) = -9.71, p < .001, r = 0.28
summaryh(lmer(formula = SWB ~ T_opp + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df))
#  b = 0.04, SE = 0.03, t(6815) = 1.28, p = .199, r = 0.02
```
